<templatestyles src="Template:Equipment/styles.css" />
[[File:Prospector_Kit_Equipment_Equip.png|100px|thumb|The stat popup for a necklace in the Prospector Kit]]
There are three types of equipment (jewelry) in the game: Necklaces, Charms, and Rings. You can wear one necklace and one charm, and up to 8 rings. Use the [[Prospector Kit]] to equip and unequip your jewelry, and/or to save or load a particular arrangement ("loadout").

Equipment can be crafted at the [[Crafting Anvil]] near the [[Blacksmith]] in multiple locations. Some equipment needs a [[Blueprint]] to be obtained before it can be crafted, while other equipment can be crafted by all players, provided they have the ingredients.

Equipment can be [[Crafting_Anvil#Quality|improved]] in multiple ways.
* When crafting, use larger/better ores to get more stars.
* Ask the Blacksmith to '''reforge''' the equipment. This has a chance (though not a guarantee unless you use a [[Perfect Reforge Token]] or pay the Blacksmith with Robux) to raise the percentage score.
* Merge two five-star equipment into one six-star equipment at the [[Magma Forge]].
* [[Mutations|Mutate]] the equipment at the forge at {{Frozen Peak}}.

== Limited-Time Equipment ==
Note: equipment that requires a blueprint can still be crafted after the event ends, assuming you acquired said blueprint during the event, and you have (or can get via {{The Void}}) the required ores. Equipment that does not have a blueprint can '''not''' be crafted after the event ends.

<sup>&nbsp;c</sup> = Catalyst for [[Mutations]]
